scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/bridge && pnpm --filter @browser-use-extension/extension build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/extension --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/bridge --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
